title: zoom
summary: Control zoom mode and programmatic axes zooming for figures and axes.
description: `zoom` toggles figure zoom mode, applies positive numeric zoom factors to axes limits, records and restores zoom baselines, and returns a MATLAB-compatible zoom handle object for `get`/`set` workflows.

arguments.name: option
arguments.description: Zoom command. `xon` and `yon` constrain zooming to one axis, `reset` records the current limits as the baseline, and `out` restores that baseline.

arguments.name: factor
arguments.description: Zoom factor applied around the current axes center. Values greater than 1 zoom in; values between 0 and 1 zoom out. Integer scalars from any native integer class are accepted.

arguments.name: ax
arguments.description: Target axes handle. Explicit axes updates do not change the current axes selection. RunMat mode additionally accepts a typed-integer alias for an encoded handle.

examples.description: Zoom in around the current axes center
examples.output: % Current axes limits shrink by a factor of 2

examples.description: Use the zoom object with get and set

notes: Statement-form `zoom()` toggles zoom mode. Output-form `z = zoom()` returns a zoom handle object.
In output context, `z = zoom(fig)` returns the zoom object for `fig`; in statement context, `zoom(factor)` applies a numeric zoom factor.
The zoom object supports live `get`/`set` for `Enable`, `Motion`, `Direction`, `RightClickAction`, `UseLegacyExplorationModes`, and callback/context-menu placeholder properties.
gpu_residency: `zoom` mutates plotting metadata only. Numeric zoom factors update stored axes limits directly and do not gather or copy GPU-resident plot data.
